from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import json,re,sys
d=Path(sys.argv[1]); classify,reasons=json.loads(sys.argv[2]); blind=(d/'part-b-blind.md').read_text(); seen=Counter(); classes=Counter(); vocab=[]
labels={'c':'convergent','h':'convergent-hole','d':'divergence','a':'artefact','b':'pass-B-blind-spot'}
valid=re.compile(r'^(transition → [A-Za-z_]+|handle|ignore \(documented\)|ignore \(accidental\)|defer \(queued\)|reject|UNSPECIFIED)$')
out=['# Part B diff','Coverage check passed for 30 catalogue events and 56 pair orderings. Each distinct Situation is classified below. The pack listed no retained or removed analysis IDs. No implementation code or residual quoted fragments were found in the dispatched package.','The coverage checker reported no explicit as-is marks. As-is dependencies remain in the descriptions of lazy time reconciliation; stored count reads; fixed Name reads; lack of per-request registry; no refund for missing reports; and mutex-serialized access or callbacks. Agreement on these behaviors is not independent where cited solely from the catalogue. The latter fields were marked observed in code in the package. The public error comments also contain an imprecise over-cap wording at equality.','| ID | Situation | Classification | Evidence, question or scope |','|---|---|---|---|']
for row in blind.splitlines():
 if not row.startswith('| ') or row.startswith('| id '):continue
 k,s,disposition,expected=[v.strip() for v in row.strip('|').split('|')]
 seen[k]+=1
 ix=seen[k]
 label,_,q=classify[k][ix-1].partition(':')
 classes[labels[label]]+=1
 rationale=reasons.get(f'{k}/{ix}')
 scope=f'{k} matrix column or {k} pair trace'
 if not rationale:
  rationale={'c':'Agrees on the observable behavior for this situation.','h':'Recognizes the behavior or a missing contract; preserve the linked question.','d':'Expected handling or ordering differs from the cited execution.','a':'Catalogue needs a clearer boundary condition.','b':'Part A retains an additional outcome under overlap or callback failure.'}[label]
 out.append(f'| {k} | {s} | {labels[label]} | {rationale} {scope}.'+(f' → Q-{q} |' if q else ' |'))
 raw=disposition.strip('`')
 if not valid.fullmatch(raw):
  terms=re.findall(r'`([^\x60]+)`',disposition)
  if not terms: terms=[raw]
  mapped=''
  if len(terms)==1 and terms[0]=='reject' and 'one wins' not in raw:
   mapped='Maps to reject when it describes a declared error/diagnostic.'
  elif 'then' in raw or 'via later' in raw:
   mapped='The named transition is the first lifecycle effect; the later operation is a separate handling phase.'
  else:
   mapped='No unique mapping; retain the question on the situation.'
  vocab.append(f'- {k} — {s}. vocabulary-drift `{raw.replace(chr(96), "")}`. {mapped}'+(f' Q-{q}.' if q else ''))
for k,v in classify.items():
 assert seen[k]==len(v),(k,seen[k],len(v))
out += ['',f'Classified {sum(classes.values())} situations. '+', '.join(f'{k} {v}' for k,v in sorted(classes.items()))+'.','','## Vocabulary drift','']+vocab
(d/'part-b-diff.md').write_text('\n'.join(out)+'\n')
print(dict(classes),len(vocab))
